name: sgs/notice-message
title: SGS Notice Message
description: One rotating or randomised message inside an SGS Notice Banner (U-15). Add two or more inside a banner to enable rotation.

message.label: Message
message._note: CONTENT-kind, block-private — no SGS_Container_Wrapper. Colour is painted TWICE by render.php: once on the banner root via :has() while this message is active (§3.1), once on the message's own uid class so stacked no-JS messages each keep their own text colour. Both reads land on the same two attrMap entries; the :has() emission is the primary paint, the own-uid rule the no-JS fallback.

innerBlocks.label: Message content
innerBlocks._note: Native InnerBlocks, no template lock and no allowedBlocks restriction (any block type; sgs/text is the seeded starter). Mirrors sgs/accordion-item's open panel-content slot.

label.description: Editor-only name shown in the list view. Never rendered on the frontend.
